description: Weighted identity resolution (ontology.identity_scoring: Fellegi-Sunter scoring with blocking keys, field comparison levels and m/u weights) over live captures: the L7 probe (scripts.ontology_projection_probe --build-only) makes or reuses the session's GET-only Portal mirror, BC capture and projection and lays them out as the served host state; then, offline and with no client, scripts.identity_scoring_probe scores every kind (parties: supplier, customer, person; documents: purchase_order, invoice, shipment; mail_sender) on a read-only connection to the served projection as the served host's capture principal, under the scope its served tools give it (audiences, markings, item gate). m comes only from identity-tier links (verified keys, reviewed links), u from value frequencies and blocked pairs, never from evaluation labels; nothing is merged: a pair at or above the review probability is a candidate carrying a plx.review accept_link payload, and only a person's review makes it a reviewed link in the next build. Recorded per kind: records, systems, pairs compared, bands (identity, rejected, review, below_review), identity links by tier, candidates offered for review and not reviewable by reason, and the two-fold evaluation on the reader's identity pairs (m never from the pair's own fold): precision on reviewed truth (precision_reviewed: a person's rejections as negatives), precision_with_closure (also other blocked records of an identity pair's systems as negatives), coverage and blocking_recall; and for the party kinds the Portal-BC pairs alone (portal_bc, by source pair bc+portal_api), with their totals. Pass = every kind scored, no scoring error, every offered payload a valid plx.review record call for its own candidate, no candidate under the review probability, no write through the scoring connection, no train/evaluation overlap, the budget holds and at least one Portal-BC party pair compared. A Portal outage blocks parts, not the check: the build reports blocked_upstream and the kinds are scored over BC (blocked, never a pass); with no record source the probe names sources_blocked. Counts, shares, booleans and kind, band, tier, reason and source names only; never a value, key, identifier or citation. Live-unverified until the live check records a result.
notes: Registered, live-unverified: no live-check result yet. Module test: injected-transport (ontology/tests/test_identity_scoring.py runs this spec's own argv over the live-wiring fixture world with the Portal and BC transports injected and checks it with live_verify.check_expectations; only the live-read label may miss there). Precision and coverage are recorded, not asserted: the schema caps every Portal-BC same_record link at lead (bc_company_not_known: the Portal does not serve the BC company), so the Portal-BC identity pairs (and so their precision and coverage) are only the reviewed links people record and are null until there are some; the customer kind's verified Portal-Sage keys give its whole-kind evaluation. m is shared across a kind's system pairs, so m learned on Portal-Sage pairs is applied to Portal-BC pairs (residual). The session projection carries no captured mail, so mail_sender scores no sender here. The reader is the served host's capture principal under examples/projection_probe_audience.live-check.json with no marking held. Timing (forecast, unmeasured): the build shares the ontology.mentions budget (2,600 s), reused from ontology.session_projection when this session committed it (session_projection.mode reused) and cold otherwise; scoring gets 900 s, checked between kinds; the first run measures seconds. Its mirror and projection are the session's (session_reads), so its failure or timeout never spoils them for the next consumer.
